title: French-Style Fish Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful French-inspired pilaf dish featuring fish as the main ingredient, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the jammy onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the dense cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the Venezuelan pilaf rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Flake in the cooked fish and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
